t: From Coleco Adam to NixOS: A Quest for a Deterministic System
s: This article details a 40-year journey seeking system stability, culminating in NixOS for its deterministic and reproducible configuration, contrasting it with system decay in traditional and containerized approaches.
sub: Evolution of system stability and reproducibility challenges.
NixOS as a solution for deterministic system configuration and long-term skill preservation.
Historical computing platforms (Coleco Adam, Commodore Amiga) and their lessons in system design.
Critique of virtual machines and containers for fundamental system management issues.
